description: Scrolls the viewport or a known scrollable element to reveal more content; prefer canonical ids or stable selectors for nested containers, and omit both for viewport scrolling.

pageId.description: Page ID whose viewport or element should be scrolled.

selector.description: Fallback CSS selector for the scroll container.

id.description: Preferred canonical element ID for the scroll container.

purpose.description: Describe why scrolling is needed, e.g., loading more results, revealing a target section, or moving inside a nested scroll container
